modmenu.descriptionTranslation.furever: Animated foxes and vanilla mobs for Minecraft menus and loading screens.
text.furever.title: Furever settings
text.furever.screen_mode.tooltip: For CUSTOM, choose screens in the Custom screens tab.
text.furever.custom_screens.tooltip: Comma-separated class names for screens not listed above. Reopen settings after visiting a screen to add it to the choices.
text.furever.position.tooltip: You can also choose a position visually with Place mob.
text.furever.orbit_radius.tooltip: Distance from the center to the mob. 45% is the new default; vanilla models only.
text.furever.clockwise.tooltip: Off: counterclockwise, like the original fox. Applies to vanilla models only.
text.furever.camera_angle.tooltip: Vanilla models only. Positive angles show the mob from above; negative angles show it from below.
text.furever.position_hint: Click or drag to place the mob
text.furever.position_arrows: Arrow keys can move it beyond the screen
